passages.provision_quote: (42) human trafficking of a minor, in violation of subdivision (c) of Section 236.1, except, with respect to a violation of paragraph (1) of subdivision (c) of Section 236.1, where the person who committed the offense was a victim of human trafficking, as described in subdivision (b) or (c) of Section 236.1, at the time of the offense;
passages.note: SB 14, authored by Grove, adds human trafficking of a minor to the Three Strikes 'serious felony' list, a penalty enhancement for one offense (annex 'one offense' rule).

rows.reasoning: SB 14 (2023-2024), authored by Grove, amends Penal Code Section 1192.7 to add human trafficking of a minor to the definition of 'serious felony' for Three Strikes purposes. Per the annex's 'one offense' hard case, a bill that raises the penalty exposure for one offense shows direction toward consequences but cannot establish the general orientation the rungs separate (rungs 3 'some people need support, some need consequences', 4 'accountability is the priority', or 5 'the toughest penalties the law allows').
